$comment: The dataset is PINNED, not vendored: it is fetched by URL and refused if the sha256 does not match.
Redistributing somebody else's dataset inside this repository would put us in the business of hosting it,
and a copy is one more thing that can drift from what the authors publish.
Re-fetched fresh 2026-09-09 on the owner's instruction, after a session had read some of the questions.
The bytes are identical to the 2026-08-28 pin, so nothing about the corpus changed — what changed is that
no local copy carries any edit or annotation from that session.
IT MAY NOT BE TOUCHED. The extraction step reads conversations and must never read the questions, the
answers or the categories. That is enforced rather than promised: `loadConversations` returns objects
carrying no question data, and a gate asserts it.

locomo.licence: TO CONFIRM before publishing any result — read the repository's LICENSE and the paper's terms, and record the answer here rather than assuming a permissive default.
